title: Rabbi Yose Tzaydenaya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was a student of Rabbi Yirmeya: Ketubot ch. 1, halakha 7; [Nazir, end of ch. 7](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Nazir.7.4.3), where he recited [a teaching] before Rabbi Yirmeya; and so one should read in Nazir ch. 3, halakha 3.

He also taught in the name of Rabbi Yohanan in [Berakhot ch. 4, halakha 4](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Berakhot.4.4.3); and it is possible that he is the one called in [Ketubot 46a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.46a.13) [by the name] Rav Yosef Tzeidoni.

notes.text: The connection between Yose Tzaydenaya and Rav Yosef Tzidoni is tentative. Hyman does not spell out exactly which part of the Nazir 3:3 wording he would correct.

The final halakhah of Nazir 7 names Rabbi Yose Tzaydenaya reciting before Rabbi Yirmeya. An [earlier passage](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Nazir.7.3.3) has only the Sidonian epithet. [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1946&lang=en) likewise cites the transmission in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. The proposed reading of Nazir 3:3 and the identification with Rav Yosef remain Hyman’s.
